{{Quote|Valarian has been bringing in off-world specialists to try to compete with my organization. The first is a spice trading specialist named Delrice Capreese.|[[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:JPJTH" />}}
'''Delrice Capreese''' was a female [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] trading specialist that lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Valarian/Legends|Lady Valarian]] brought Capreese to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to help in her attempts to compete with [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|crime organization]].<ref name="SWG:JPJTH" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Jabba ordered a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to eliminate Capreese to disrupt Lady Valarian's efforts. The spacer then tracked Delrice Capreese to her camp in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] and killed her.<ref name="SWG:JPJTH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Delrice Capreese was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:JPJTH" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Delrice Capreese was added to the game as part of the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Jabba's Theme Park|Jabba's Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:JPJTH" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
